name: update-labels
description: Create or update GitHub repository labels from a JSON file or inline list.

REPOSITORY.description: Repository in the format "owner/name". Defaults to the current repository.

LABELS_FILE.description: Path to labels.json file. Defaults to .github/labels.json if it exists.

LABELS.description: Comma-separated list of label names with optional numbers (e.g., "25 documentation,10 must,20 should"). Used if labels-file does not exist.
LABELS.default: 25 documentation,10 must,20 should,30 could,80 duplicate,90 wont
